title: A required note must be filled in to submit, and is listed as outstanding
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with "Settings - Service" enabled, on the build under test.
  • A template with a checkbox field that has "Note required if Monitor / Not OK" on, and a per-axle field with it on.
  • You are filling an inspection against that template, with "Work order lines - Create & Edit" enabled.
custom_steps:
1. On the checkbox field, select Monitor or Not OK, leave the note empty, and try to Submit.
  2. Before submitting, open the outstanding-items list and look for the field.
  3. On the per-axle field, set a single position to Not OK and check whether a note is required.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With the option on, choosing Monitor or Not OK requires a note before the inspection can be submitted.
  • The requirement is enforced at Submit, not only while filling the form.
  • Before submit, the field appears in the outstanding-items list, so the technician is not rejected by an avoidable error.
  • On a per-axle field the note requirement is driven by the verdicts on the positions, not a stored axle roll-up; a single Not OK position requires the note as soon as it is set, and the requirement triggers when any axle is marked Monitor or Not OK.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9099 (S1 — Require a note on flagged responses); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S1; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R3: “When the option is on and the technician selects Monitor or Not OK, a note will be required before the inspection can be submitted”
  • S1-R4: “The system will enforce the requirement on submit, not only while the technician is filling the form”
  • S1-R5: “Before submit, the technician will see the field listed among the outstanding items, so they are not rejected by an error they could have avoided”
  • S1-R7: “On a per-axle field the requirement is triggered by the verdicts recorded on the positions, not by an axle's stored roll-up. A single Not OK tire will require the note as soon as it is set”
  • S1-E5: “On a per-axle field, the requirement triggers when any axle is marked Monitor or Not OK”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
